$description: SearchField (platform/components/SearchField), library wave 6, lane B: the tokens of its list of suggestions and recent searches. The list is a menu surface with the combobox list's roles; the field's own tokens are in the shared set.

search-popup-background.$description: Search list: the overlay surface (the combobox list's).

search-popup-shadow.$description: Search list: the menu elevation (the combobox list's).

search-popup-margin-block-start.$description: Search list: the space between the field and the list.

search-popup-padding-block.$description: Search list: the space above and below its options.

search-popup-padding-inline.$description: Search list: the space beside its options.

search-popup-z-index.$description: Search list: drawn on the menu layer, over the content under the field.

search-popup-head-gap.$description: Recent searches heading: the space between its title and its Clear button.

search-popup-head-padding-block-start.$description: Recent searches heading: the space above it.

search-popup-head-padding-block-end.$description: Recent searches heading: the space under it.

search-popup-head-padding-inline.$description: Recent searches heading: the space beside it (the combobox group heading's).

search-popup-title-text.$description: Recent searches heading: its color (the combobox group heading's).

search-popup-title-font-family.$description: Recent searches heading: the label font.

search-list-max-height.$description: Search list: the tallest the options grow before they scroll (the combobox list's).

search-option-gap.$description: Search option: the space between its icon and its text.

search-option-font-size.$description: Search option: its text size (the combobox option's).

search-option-min-height.$description: Search option: its height (the inline control height).

search-option-padding-inline.$description: Search option: the space beside its content.

search-option-active-background.$description: Search option: the active option (keyboard or pointer), as in the combobox list.

search-option-icon-text.$description: Search option: its icon (search, or the clock of a recent search).

search-option-description-text.$description: Search option: its description under the label.

search-match-font-weight.$description: Search option: the part of a suggestion that matches the text, in bold.

search-bar-width.$description: SearchField width="bar": the command bar search, one fixed width in every bar (owner, 2026-10-14: 240px, never squeezed).

search-over-background.$description: SearchField collapsed, opened: the band across the bar that holds the field, the bar's own white surface.

search-over-radius.$description: SearchField collapsed, opened: the band's corners (the command bar's).

search-over-padding-inline.$description: SearchField collapsed, opened: the space beside the field in the band (the command bar's padding).

search-over-z-index.$description: SearchField collapsed, opened: the band lies over the bar's other controls.
